# MinIO Service
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.minio.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.minio.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, storage |
MinIO S3-compatible object storage server with the console enabled. Used as the
blob store for ingested artifacts and intermediate pipeline outputs.
